sourceSentences: While Ranger's Focus is inactive, Ashe's basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Focus for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
For 6 seconds, Ashe gains bonus attack speed and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal modified physical damage.
Ranger's Focus resets Ashe's basic attack timer.
Flat damage reductions (e.g. Tantrum, Nimble Fighter, or Eclipse) apply per arrow, resulting in extremely increased effectiveness against Ranger's Focus.
Ranger's Focus also empowers Wind's Fury bolts to become a flurry of 5 bolts each as well.
The bolts are evenly distributed among the targets, but a single target cannot be hit by more than 5 bolts.
Ashe's critical strikes double Frost's slow strength, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.
The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing them magic damage, stunning them for a duration based on distance traveled, and granting sight of the area around them for 1 second.
Ashe marks enemy champions who were previously unseen but were revealed by Hawkshot in order to gain assist credit, lasting for the standard credit timer.
